payload.purpose_context: doc-kitty treats presentations as a first-class output pillar alongside the docsite. Mission M6 lets anyone author a deck in ordinary Markdown (kind: Presentation) and have the build split it into reveal.js slides, rendered out-of-frame with a mandatory no-JS linear fallback, themed through the site's own design tokens, and discoverable in sitemap, llms.txt, the agent API, and search — with no hand-authored slide HTML and no new authoring DSL.
payload.purpose_tldr: Authors write slide decks as plain Markdown; the build renders them as static, accessible reveal.js presentations.

payload.wp_title: Deck a11y (static axe both modes + Playwright interaction test)
Published deck + overview + pins + build assertions (atomic)
Docs of record: resolve open questions + amend ADR-0012
Foundation: deck route, layout, reveal, theme, guardrails
Discovery wiring (RSS exclusion + section labelling), before the deck
